Subject: POC trial planning - RACI & next steps (Aurora Health)

Hi Sara / Jon —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC/trial running smoothly. I captured the success criteria and an initial RACI + timeline (attached) for your review.

Recap / Success criteria (proposed)
- Accuracy: Redwood-powered assistant answers to clinical triage questions should match SME answers >= 85% on our test set (50 prompts).
- Latency: 95th percentile response time < 500ms for typical patient-summary requests during evaluation window.
- Cost: Token/unit cost stays within agreed trial cap (we proposed $X/day estimate in the attached timeline).
- Integration: App team can call Redwood API and validate 1 end-to-end flow in staging by week 2.
- Security: No PHI persisted in Redwood logs; KMS for keys and audit logs enabled during the trial.

Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (prep): Shared test prompts + access to sandbox account, security questionnaire turn-around.
- Week 1-2: Integration + smoke tests (app + infra).
- Week 3: Handful of controlled evaluation sessions, collect metrics.
- Week 4: Final evaluation and go/no-go meeting.

Ownership ask (quick)
- Can you confirm who owns the following on your side so we can finalize the RACI?
  - Infra (VPC, cloud infra, network peering)
  - App (integration, feature owner)
  - Security / Compliance (SOC 2 review, data handling)
  - Procurement / Legal (PO, contract redlines)

Attachments: raci_matrix_aurora_v1.xlsx, poc-timeline-aurora_v1.pdf (first pass)

Proposed next steps
1) Confirm owners by EOD Wed (9/16) — we'll update the RACI and send a final SOW.
2) Security questionnaire: Sara — please suggest any outstanding docs we need.
3) Procurement: Jon — let us know your PO process and timelines so we can align.

I'm looping in Lauren (solutions lead) and Aditya (inference lead) for any technical clarifications.

Thanks,
Marissa

Subject: Re: POC trial planning - RACI & next steps (Aurora Health)

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — very helpful. A few clarifications from the tech/security side:

Infra ownership
- Infra: I (Sara) will own the Aurora side infra setup (VPC, peering, staging cluster). I'll coordinate with our cloud infra team (cc'd: "InfraOps" via ticket) for peering windows.

App ownership
- App: Product lead is Jon Walker (jon.walker@aurorahealth.org). He'll be the integration owner; I can help with API contract reviews.

Security/compliance
- Security: I'm the point for security reviews, but final sign-off will come from our InfoSec (approval needed for KMS/HSM visibility). We will need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II and evidence of data retention policies. Can you share those now?

Success criteria tweaks
- Accuracy: 85% on the 50-prompt set sounds good, but can we make it 2-tier: 85% for core triage prompts, 75% for edge-case prompts so expectations are aligned?
- Latency: 95th < 500ms is aggressive; can you confirm typical request sizes? If the average token length is > 1k tokens the 500ms may not be feasible.

Procurement
- Jon (Matthews): procurement@aurorahealth.org will handle the PO. Typical turnaround is 2-3 weeks after SOW is approved.

I attached a short list of required artifacts for security review (I'll paste below) — if you can point me to those in the Drive it speeds things up.

Required artifacts for security review (initial)
- SOC 2 Type II report
- Data retention + deletion policy for trial data
- KMS architecture doc / key access policy
- Any third-party subprocessors list

Quote from the deck: we're good to proceed with the timeline if we can get infra peering scheduled in week 1 and security artifacts by the end of week 0.

On the accuracy split, we're fine with core/edge tiers — I'll confirm with Jon Walker on the prompt list.

—Sara
Sara Lee

Thanks Sara / Jon — great notes. Below are concrete answers and an updated RACI (attached).

Quick answers
- SOC 2 Type II: attaching latest report (link in Drive). We'll also provide the data retention + deletion policy and subprocessors list by EOD Wednesday.
- Latency: typical request size for the clinical prompts we tested is ~350-450 tokens; 500ms 95th is achievable in Dedicated mode. I'll let Aditya confirm any micro-tuning we should do for the staging run.
- Network: Redwood does not require inbound IP openings from Aurora. We prefer outbound authenticated connections from your VPC to our dedicated egress endpoint (we'll supply egress IPs and a cgnat-friendly hostname).

Updated RACI (high-level)
